opportunities.name: Bravado armor boxer
opportunities.objective: Test bravado armor boxer against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Bravado grants two rapid attacks after a spell, with bonus magic damage scaling from source armor; Dazzle also has a 0.5 source-armor term. Iceborn adds a physical Spellblade and slow while Q gains charges from actual Bravado attacks, supporting a mixed-damage melee loop.
opportunities.requiredState: Have enough mana and an attackable target through Dazzle's one-second delay.
opportunities.failure: Kiting prevents attack refunds and Frozen Heart's mana cannot fix poor access.
opportunities.test: Count Q charges, E casts and personal attacks over ten seconds.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Attack speed does not itself generate free Bravado charges without spell casts.

opportunities.name: Damage charge heal conductor
opportunities.objective: Test damage charge heal conductor against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Bravado attacks supply damage and Q charges; Q heals each stack with AP and health terms, creating a repeated Helia damage-to-heal cycle. Bastion duplicates spell origins around the tethered ally, while armor and mana from Frozen Heart help Taric keep attacking through the delayed R protection.
opportunities.requiredState: A nearby Bastion ally and enemies in personal attack reach.
opportunities.failure: Mana starvation, severed tether range or burst before R's 2.5-second delay loses the loop.
opportunities.test: Measure Helia charges and allied healing for two-stack Q cycles.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Duplicated Bastion origins do not imply the same ally receives two full copies of every heal.

ruledOut.reason: Attack speed does not itself generate free Bravado charges without spell casts.

unknowns: Current-patch proc ordering/effectiveness is untested; symbolic source stats and helper form/pet records are not runtime dispatch proof.

builds.name: Bravado armor boxer
builds.summary: Test bravado armor boxer against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test bravado armor boxer against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Bravado grants two rapid attacks after a spell, with bonus magic damage scaling from source armor; Dazzle also has a 0.5 source-armor term. Iceborn adds a physical Spellblade and slow while Q gains charges from actual Bravado attacks, supporting a mixed-damage melee loop.
testPlan: Required state: Have enough mana and an attackable target through Dazzle's one-second delay.
Count Q charges, E casts and personal attacks over ten seconds.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Kiting prevents attack refunds and Frozen Heart's mana cannot fix poor access.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Attack speed does not itself generate free Bravado charges without spell casts.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Iceborn Gauntlet, Frozen Heart, Terminus, Spirit Visage, Titanic Hydra, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
